data.name: Thala
data.long_meaning: Thala means 'God' or 'King' in Tamil language. It is a unisex name that represents power, strength, and courage. In Hinduism, Thala is also a name for Lord Murugan, the god of war and victory.
data.spiritual_meaning: Thala is a divine name that symbolizes the presence and protection of the gods. It represents the power and strength of the universe and inspires courage and leadership in the bearer.
data.numerology_meaning: Thala is a name that vibrates with the energy of the number 3, which represents creativity, self-expression, and communication. It suggests that the bearer is a natural leader and communicator, and has a strong creative drive.

data.cultural_impact: Thala holds significant cultural implications as it is a name held in reverence in the Tamil community. It denotes respect, autonomy, and the ability to lead and take charge. Thala is also commonly used as a title for leaders, for instance, 'Thalaivar' which translates to 'Leader' in Tamil, and is a term used for political leaders, actors, and community heads. The name Thala evokes a sense of majesty and strength.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Thala is a divine name that embodies power and strength, symbolizing God or a King. In Hinduism, Lord Murugan, also known as Thaliyonalan, is associated with this name. Murugan is the god of war and victory, and Thala symbolizes the divine protection and guidance that he provides His devotees. Thala also signifies the steady and unwavering nature of grace and love, reminding the devotee of the stability and steadfastness of God.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Thala was a title given to the head of a village or a local chief in ancient India. The name Thala carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Thala was a title of respect and authority, signifying leadership and protection.
